K01.drivers: Typical adult proportions; mild chest/bust volume, moderate hips, normal limb taper and knee/ankle transitions

K02.drivers: Lean average male-type build, straight trunk, ordinary limb proportions

K03.drivers: Profile shows a strongly arched, forward-bulging chest over a deeply concave lower back and a deep waist pinch; upper-trunk mass sits high and forward. Thin, stalk-like legs with knobbly knees that bulge backward, and a shin that angles forward under them. Front view has a narrow tapering trunk, bony elbows, and thin forearms and shanks

K04.drivers: Slim ordinary build, normal segment relations

K05.drivers: Slim ordinary build, slight bust, normal proportions

K06.drivers: Average build, slightly broader thighs, normal structure

K07.drivers: Ordinary build with a soft belly and a fuller abdomen in profile; otherwise normal structure

K08.drivers: Very pronounced hourglass shape: wide hips and thighs, narrow waist, wide rounded shoulders, long arms. Still reads as a human female-type structure with ordinary joints

K09.drivers: Average to slightly heavy build, belly and gluteal projection; ordinary structure

K11.drivers: Same pattern as K03, but more pronounced: a large forward-arched chest bulge over a very concave lumbar region and a pinched waist, with mass concentrated in the upper trunk. Thin legs with prominent backward-bulging knees and an angled shank. Bony elbows, wrists and forearms

distinguishing_features: I see only one non-human group: K03 and K11. Both have an arched, forward-projecting chest over a deeply concave lower back, a pinched waist, thin limbs and knee joints that protrude backward with an angle break at the knee. They differ from every other body in how the body is put together, not in size or fat. K11 is the stronger example. K08 is an outlier only because of its exaggerated hourglass shape, and it otherwise reads as human.
